lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai j sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||
lines.translation: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is permeating and pervading in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai j dedaa rijak sabaahi ||
lines.translation: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of sustenance to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu iko kar saalaaheeai j satigur deeaa dikhaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! - praise the One Lord, revealed by the True Guru. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu guramukh sadaa karahi manamukh marahi bikh khaai ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Gurmukhs praise the Lord continually, while the self-willed manmukhs eat poison and die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa vaahu vaahu na bhaavaee dukhe dukh vihaai ||
lines.translation: They have no love for the Lord's Praises, and they pass their lives in misery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh a(n)mrit peevanaa vaahu vaahu karahi liv laai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, and they center their consciousness on the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu karahi se jan niramale tribhavan sojhee paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! are immaculate and pure; they obtain the knowledge of the three worlds. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaanai gur milai sevaa bhagat baneejai ||
lines.translation: By the Lord's Will, one meets the Guru, serves Him, and worships the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaanai har man vasai sahaje ras peejai ||
lines.translation: By the Lord's Will, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and one easily drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਿਤ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaanai sukh paaeeai har laahaa nit leejai ||
lines.translation: By the Lord's Will, one finds peace, and continually earns the Lord's Profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai takhat bahaaleeai nij ghar sadaa vaseejai ||
lines.translation: He is seated on the Lord's throne, and he dwells continually in the home of his own being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਨੀ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa bhaanaa tinee ma(n)niaa jinaa guroo mileejai ||16||
lines.translation: He alone surrenders to the Lord's Will, who meets the Guru. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu se jan sadaa karahi jinh kau aape dei bujhaai ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Those humble beings ever praise the Lord, unto whom the Lord Himself grants understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa man niramal hovai haumai vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, the mind is purified, and egotism departs from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਜੋ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu gurasikh jo nit kare so man chi(n)diaa phal paai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh who continually chants Waaho! Waaho! attains the fruits of his heart's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karahi se jan sohane har tinh kai sa(n)g milaai ||
lines.translation: Beauteous are those humble beings who chant Waaho! Waaho! O Lord, let me join them!

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਚਰਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu hiradai ucharaa mukhahu bhee vaahu vaahu kareu ||
lines.translation: Within my heart, I chant Waaho! Waaho!, and with my mouth, Waaho! Waaho!

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu jo karahi hau tan man tinh kau deu ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! - unto them I dedicate my body and mind. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu saahib sach hai a(n)mrit jaa kaa naau ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Lord Master; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin seviaa tin phal paaiaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the Lord are blessed with the fruit; I am a sacrifice to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu gunee nidhaan hai jis no dei s khaai ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the treasure of virtue; he alone tastes it, who is so blessed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu jal thal bharapoor hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is pervading and permeating the oceans and the land; the Gurmukh attains Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨਿਤ ਸਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu gurasikh nit sabh karahu gur poore vaahu vaahu bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Let all the Gursikhs continually praise Him. Waaho! Waaho! The Perfect Guru is pleased with His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu jo man chit kare tis jamaka(n)kar neR na aavai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who chants Waaho! Waaho! with his heart and mind - the Messenger of Death does not approach him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu sachaa sach hai sachee gurabaanee ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is the Truest of the True; True is the Word of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur te sach pachhaaneeai sach sahaj samaanee ||
lines.translation: Through the True Guru, the Truth is realized, and one is easily absorbed in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਨਾ ਸਵਹਿ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin jaagahi naa savahi jaagat rain vihaanee ||
lines.translation: Night and day, they remain awake, and do not sleep; in wakefulness, the night of their lives passes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee har ras chaakhiaa se pu(n)n paraanee ||
lines.translation: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, are the most worthy persons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣੀ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur kinai na paaio pach mue ajaanee ||17||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; the ignorant rot away and die. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee nira(n)kaar hai tis jevad avar na koi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani, the Word, of the Formless Lord. There is no other as great as He is.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu agam athaahu hai vaahu vaahu sachaa soi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is unfathomable and inaccessible. Waaho! Waaho! He is the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu veparavaahu hai vaahu vaahu kare s hoi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! He is the self-existent Lord. Waaho! Waaho! As He wills, so it comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu a(n)mrit naam hai guramukh paavai koi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtained by the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karamee paaeeai aap daiaa kar dei ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! This is realized by His Grace, as He Himself grants His Grace.
